description: Your clinic's plan, the modules it switches on and how much of it you use.

usage.title: Usage
usage.over: Over the plan's limit: nothing more can be added until the plan changes.

modules.coreHint: Every clinic has these, on every plan.
modules.addOnsHint: Switched on by your plan, or added to it.

descriptions.ORG: Branches, rooms, working hours, holidays and clinic settings.
descriptions.STF: Staff invitations, roles per branch and permissions.
descriptions.ACC: Sign-up with a mobile number, sign-in by phone or email.
descriptions.SVC: The service catalog and the price list, per branch or doctor.
descriptions.SCH: Doctor shifts, leave and bookable slots.
descriptions.APT: Every booking: book, reschedule, cancel, check in and complete. Includes the dashboard.
descriptions.NTF: In-app, email and WhatsApp messages in Arabic and English.
descriptions.AUD: Who changed what and when, on every sensitive record.
descriptions.FD: Walk-ins, the live queue, the waiting-room screen and nurse triage.
descriptions.BIL: Invoices from visits, cash and card at the desk, cash sessions and daily close.
descriptions.EMR: Notes, diagnoses, prescriptions and orders, signed and locked.
descriptions.INS: Payers, policies, the co-pay split, pre-authorizations and claims.
descriptions.RPT: Reports and exports beyond the dashboard.
descriptions.PAT: Online booking with prices, and the patient's records and invoices.
descriptions.REC: Doctors apply with a CV and move through interview to acceptance.
descriptions.BOT: An Arabic and English assistant that answers questions and finds slots.

demo.title: Demo: change the plan
demo.intro: This stands in for the platform operator, so a presentation can show what each plan unlocks. Menus change at once.
